Called meeting of City Council,
Austin Tex. Jan. 6th 1874.

Mayor T. B. Wheeler in the chair. Aldermen present G T Boardman, C. Bremond, Wm
Bruggierhoff, Ed. Christian, F. Dohme, N.B. Mitche- J. H. Robinson. Aldermen absent H. H.
Metz and S. H. Todd.

The Mayor said that the meeting was called to receive the report from the Fire Committee
with regard the purchase of another Fire Engine Fire Committee reported, and recommend the
purchase of one of Silsby's 4th Size Rotary — Steam Fire Engines. The report was received
and adopted.

It was moved that the Mayor be authorized to purchase from the Silsby's Manufacturing Co.
one 4th Size Rotary Steam Fire Engine one Hose Reel, and all other apparatus belonging to
said Engine according to proposition of Silsby's Manufg. Co. by S. McDowall Agt.
The yeas and nays being called, the motion was sustained by the following vote: Yeas — G T
Boardman, C. Bremond, Wm Brueggkhoff, Ed. Christian, F. Dohme, N. B. Mitchell and
J. H. Robinson. Nays — none.
Resignation of Alderman H. H. Metz was
read and accepted.
It was then on motion resolved that the
Mayor be authorized to order an election in conformity with the Charter and ordinances of
this city for an Alderman in the first ward and also he be authorized to appoint such
parties to act as judges & clerks of said election as he may see proper.
On motion Council adjourned.
Fred Sterzing
Recorder
